dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: Lil' Floaty's doing just great, and all thanks to you!

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: Although he's lost his reputation as a well-known architect and still owes a lot of money as compensation for damages, he's finally back on the right track. He's less mentally burdened these days, too.

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: *sigh* That's life. What isn't meant to be yours will always remain beyond reach — plus, being a loyal assistant isn't so bad. If the old man were here, I'm sure he'd give his approval.
